### Abstract and motivation for the site project

I am creating a website that allows the user to input existential risk probabilities for different time periods. The site then calculates the expected longevity of humankind (measured in expected years the humankind will exist or in expected human lives left, for example). Results are also visualized.

The motivation behind the site is to demonstrate, in a concise and easily digestible manner, that even very small improvements in existential risk will pay off immensely in the long run, in terms of humankind’s expected longevity. This should encourage us to pursue these improvements in various ways.

### Layout sketches and prototypes

Layout of the site plays an important role in the site functonality. Below, there are different sketches and prototypes for the layout of the site. I'm not sure yet if I want to focus on any one kind of layout, or develop multiple at one time. This might depend on the time/funding I have to work on the project.

![Layout type](images/uu2.png)

Below are two early, fully interactive version of the site, that I produced with Claude Code. They are still running entirely in browser instead of external server, so the first load takes a few seconds while the R runtime downloads and they might feel a bit sluggish. Also, I haven't really planned them for mobile use yet.

The first one focuses on presenting a lot of variables (inputs/outputs). Click any extinction probability, survival probability or potential-population digit and adjust it with the arrows, arrow keys, or by typing a number. For example, decreasing the annual extinction probability over just the next ten years from 0.05% to 0.049% would save over 10 million lives in expectation over the next 1000 years, with all else equal.

[Open the app full-screen in a new tab ↗](https://villeseppala.github.io/interests/articles/xriskb-app.html){target="_blank"}

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: "clamp(900px, 92vh, 1150px)"
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Extinction-risk visualiser, variant B: the same page as app_xrisk, but every edit is handled in the
# browser. The cascade, the table, the summary, the baselines, undo/redo and the time-scale change all
# run in JavaScript (below); R only serves the page once and the server does nothing per edit.
# That makes edits instant in the shinylive (webR) embed, where app_xrisk re-renders the table through
# webR on every keystroke. app_xrisk stays the reference: this file mirrors its model (the year-by-year
# cascade) and its markup, so the two can be compared number for number.
#
# Run:  shiny::runApp("app_xriskb")
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

library(shiny)

# ── settings the page needs when it is built (the model itself lives in the JavaScript) ──
SCALE_EXP <- 2:5                                 # time-scale slider: 10^2 .. 10^5 years
DEF_EXP   <- 3                                   # default horizon 1 000 years — keep equal to DEF_EXP in the JS

# metric rows, in display order: data-row id -> label in the "Variables" dropdown
VAR_ROWS <- c("Annual extinction probability"   = "rate",
              "Cumulative survival probability" = "surv",
              "Cumulative survived years"       = "years",
              "Cumulative survived generations" = "gens",
              "Annual population potential"     = "pop",
              "Annual population"               = "popexp",
              "Cumulative life-years"           = "ly",
              "Cumulative lives"                = "lives")
# rows shown on first load (the rest start unticked in the Variables menu)
VAR_ON <- setdiff(VAR_ROWS, c("gens", "ly"))

# ── UI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# styles: copied verbatim from app_xrisk/app.R

js <- r"(
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// The whole per-edit loop runs here — model → table HTML → arrows — with no R involved.
// Sections: model · formatting · cells and rows · state, baselines and history · editing (as in
// app_xrisk) · arrows and column fitting (as in app_xrisk) · controls.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── model (mirrors app_xrisk's R: START, ALL_RATES, POP0, LIFE_EXP, model_for, fit_state, compute) ──
var START = 2026, LIFE_EXP = 75, POP0 = 8.3e9;
var DEF_EXP = 3;                                  // default horizon 10^3 years; the slider's R default must match
var ALL_RATES = [0.0005, 0.0005, 0.0001, 0.00005, 0.00001];   // per period: 0.05%, 0.05%, 0.01%, 0.005%, 0.001% a year
var COL_RATE = '#e8836f', COL_SURV = '#4fb8d6', COL_POP = '#e46ba6';
var GOOD = '#7fd18f', BAD = '#ee4d4d', ZERO = '#8a97a3';
var ROWS = ['rate', 'surv', 'years', 'gens', 'pop', 'popexp', 'ly', 'lives'];   // display order

// Checkpoints are START plus every power of ten up to the horizon (2026, 2036, 2126, 3026, ...); the
// periods between them are 10, 90, 900, ... years long.
function modelFor(e){
  var cps = [START];
  for(var k = 1; k <= e; k++) cps.push(START + Number('1e' + k));
  var n = cps.length, segStart = [], segEnd = [], segLen = [], defPops = [];
  for(var i = 0; i < n - 1; i++){ segStart.push(cps[i] + 1); segEnd.push(cps[i + 1]); segLen.push(cps[i + 1] - cps[i]); }
  for(var j = 0; j < n; j++) defPops.push(POP0);
  return {n:n, cps:cps, segStart:segStart, segEnd:segEnd, segLen:segLen, defRates:ALL_RATES.slice(0, n - 1), defPops:defPops};
}
// Fit a {rates, pops} state to a model's size: keep the values for the periods both share, fill the rest
// with defaults (a horizon change keeps the reader's edits to the early periods).
function fitState(s, M){
  function fill(x, def){ var out = def.slice(); for(var k = 0; k < Math.min(x.length, def.length); k++) out[k] = +x[k]; return out; }
  return {rates: fill(s.rates, M.defRates), pops: fill(s.pops, M.defPops)};
}
// The cascade, year by year exactly as the R version, read off at the checkpoints. Potential population
// is interpolated geometrically between checkpoints; a checkpoint year takes the value of the period that
// starts there (as build_pop, where the later period overwrites the shared endpoint). Survival is the
// running product of (1 - rate); the cumulative totals count every year after START.
function compute(rates, pops, M){
  var cps = M.cps, n = M.n;
  var o = {rates:rates, growth:[NaN], surv:[], popPot:[], popExp:[], cumYears:[], cumLy:[], cumLyPot:[],
           lives:[], gens:[], livesPot:[]};
  var surv = 1, cy = 0, cly = 0, clyp = 0;
  function record(pop){
    o.surv.push(surv); o.popPot.push(pop); o.popExp.push(pop * surv);
    o.cumYears.push(cy); o.cumLy.push(cly); o.cumLyPot.push(clyp);
    o.lives.push(cly / LIFE_EXP); o.gens.push(cy / LIFE_EXP); o.livesPot.push(clyp / LIFE_EXP);
  }
  record(pops[0]);
  for(var i = 0; i < n - 1; i++){
    var y0 = cps[i], y1 = cps[i + 1], v0 = pops[i], ratio = pops[i + 1] / v0, span = y1 - y0, r = rates[i];
    var pop = v0;
    for(var y = y0 + 1; y <= y1; y++){
      pop = (y === y1 && i < n - 2) ? pops[i + 1] : v0 * Math.pow(ratio, (y - y0) / span);
      surv *= 1 - r;
      cy += surv; cly += pop * surv; clyp += pop;
    }
    record(pop);
    o.growth.push(Math.pow(pops[i + 1] / pops[i], 1 / span) - 1);
  }
  return o;
}

// ── formatting (R's formatC / f_int / group3 equivalents) ──
// thousands separators (a plain space) into a digit string: "1234567" → "1 234 567"
function group3(s){
  var out = '';
  for(var i = 0; i < s.length; i++){ if(i > 0 && (s.length - i) % 3 === 0) out += ' '; out += s.charAt(i); }
  return out;
}
// formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d[, big.mark = " "])
function fmtF(x, d, big){
  if(isNaN(x)) return 'NaN';
  if(!isFinite(x)) return x > 0 ? 'Inf' : '-Inf';
  var s = x.toFixed(d), neg = s.charAt(0) === '-';
  if(neg) s = s.slice(1);
  if(big){ var p = s.split('.'); p[0] = group3(p[0]); s = p.join('.'); }
  return (neg ? '-' : '') + s;
}
function fInt(x){ return fmtF(Math.round(x), 0, true); }
function fPct(x){ return fmtF(x * 100, 4) + '%'; }
function fYears(x){ return fmtF(x, 4, true) + 'y'; }
function fmtYear(y){ return y >= 10000 ? group3(String(y)) : String(y); }   // thin separator only for 5+ digits
// baseline text for the ref slot: same display scale / decimals as the value it sits beside
function fRef(v, toDisp, decimals, suffix){ return '(' + fmtF(v * toDisp, decimals, true) + suffix + ')'; }
function sty(col){ return col == null ? '' : ' style="color:' + col + ';"'; }
// formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 6): R writes at least two exponent digits (1.000000e-05)
function expR(x){ return x.toExponential(6).replace(/e([+-])(\d)$/, function(m, s, d){ return 'e' + s + '0' + d; }); }

// ── cells and rows: the same markup app_xrisk's R builds ──
// Digit slots for a number (value or its delta), as HTML text. See build_slots in app_xrisk for the
// layout rules. o: pad, editable (default true), digitColor(is0, lead), signChar, signColor, refTxt, refGhost.
function buildSlots(nat, toDisp, decimals, suffix, o){
  o = o || {};
  var editable = o.editable !== false, pad = o.pad, digitColor = o.digitColor, k;
  var parts = fmtF(Math.abs(nat) * toDisp, decimals).split('.'), ip = parts[0];
  if(pad != null && ip.length < pad) ip = new Array(pad - ip.length + 1).join('0') + ip;
  ip = group3(ip);
  var chars = (parts.length > 1 ? ip + '.' + parts[1] : ip).split(''), n = chars.length;
  var dot = chars.indexOf('.'); if(dot < 0) dot = n;
  var isdig = chars.map(function(c){ return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; });
  var place = new Array(n), nInt = 0, seenInt = 0, dec = 0;   // place value of each digit, in native units
  for(k = 0; k < dot; k++) if(isdig[k]) nInt++;
  for(k = 0; k < n; k++){
    if(!isdig[k]) continue;
    if(k < dot){ seenInt++; place[k] = Number('1e' + (nInt - seenInt)) / toDisp; }
    else { dec++; place[k] = Number('1e-' + dec) / toDisp; }
  }
  var lead = [], seen = false;                                  // zeros before the first significant digit
  for(k = 0; k < n; k++){
    lead[k] = false;
    if(isdig[k]){ if(!seen && chars[k] === '0') lead[k] = true; else seen = true; }
  }
  var sepCol = digitColor ? digitColor(false, false) : null;
  var up = editable ? '<span class="ar up">&#9650;</span>' : '';
  var dn = editable ? '<span class="ar dn">&#9660;</span>' : '';
  var sp = editable ? '<span class="arsp"></span>' : '';
  function sepSlot(txt, cls, col){
    return '<span class="sep">' + sp + '<b class="' + (cls || 'dch') + '"' + sty(col === undefined ? sepCol : col) + '>' +
           txt + '</b>' + sp + '</span>';
  }
  var groups = [], g = '';                     // thousands-groups: a space starts a new one
  for(k = 0; k < n; k++){
    var ch = chars[k], slot;
    if(isdig[k]){
      var col = digitColor ? digitColor(ch === '0', lead[k]) : ((pad != null && lead[k]) ? ZERO : null);
      slot = '<span class="dig" data-delta="' + expR(place[k]) + '">' + up +
             '<b class="dch"' + sty(col) + '>' + ch + '</b>' + dn + '</span>';
    } else slot = sepSlot(ch === ' ' ? '&nbsp;' : ch);
    if(ch === ' ' && k > 0){ groups.push(g); g = ''; }
    g += slot;
  }
  groups.push(g);
  if(o.signChar != null) groups[0] = sepSlot(o.signChar, 'dch sgn', o.signColor == null ? null : o.signColor) + groups[0];
  if(suffix) groups[groups.length - 1] += sepSlot(suffix, 'dch suf');
  var out = groups.map(function(x){ return '<span class="dgroup">' + x + '</span>'; }).join('');
  if(o.refTxt != null)
    out += '<span class="dgroup">' + sepSlot(o.refTxt, o.refGhost ? 'dch vref ghost' : 'dch vref', null) + '</span>';
  return out;
}
// a value cell on the grid (spans 2 half-columns); node = the arrow endpoint id ("row:j")
function vcellHtml(col, inner, cls, attrs){
  return '<div class="' + (cls || 'vcell') + '" style="grid-column:' + col + '/span 2;"' + (attrs || '') + '>' + inner + '</div>';
}
function nodeAttr(node){ return node ? ' data-node="' + node + '"' : ''; }
// delta colouring shared by both value-cell kinds: grey ± when the change rounds to zero in display
function deltaLook(dv, toDisp, decimals, good, eps){
  var cpos = good === 'more_bad' ? BAD : GOOD, cneg = good === 'more_bad' ? GOOD : BAD;
  var dshow = fmtF(Math.abs(dv) * toDisp, decimals);
  var dz = Math.abs(dv) < eps || !/[1-9]/.test(dshow);
  var dcol = dz ? ZERO : (dv > 0 ? cpos : cneg);
  return {col: dcol, sgn: dz ? '±' : (dv > 0 ? '+' : '−'), digitColor: function(is0, lead){ return lead ? ZERO : dcol; }};
}
// fixed value in a row of editable cells: a spacer where the ▲ row would be keeps its number level
function gcellFixed(col, v, toDisp, decimals, suffix, color, pad, node){
  return vcellHtml(col, '<div class="vstack"><div class="arsp"></div><div class="vmain digits"' + sty(color) + '>' +
    buildSlots(v, toDisp, decimals, suffix, {pad: pad, editable: false}) + '</div></div>', 'vcell', nodeAttr(node));
}
// editable value cell (per-digit spinner) with its delta row.
// o: col, cur, ref, kind, vi, toDisp, decimals, suffix, good, sub, color, pad, top, refTxt, node
function gcellEdit(o){
  var dv = o.cur - o.ref, d = deltaLook(dv, o.toDisp, o.decimals, o.good, 1e-12);
  return vcellHtml(o.col,
    (o.top != null ? '<div class="vtop">' + o.top + '</div>' : '') +
    '<div class="vstack">' +
      '<div class="vmain digits"' + sty(o.color) + '>' +
        buildSlots(o.cur, o.toDisp, o.decimals, o.suffix, {pad: o.pad, refTxt: o.refTxt}) + '</div>' +
      '<div class="vdelta digits">' +                         // no ▲/▼ on deltas — number-key entry only
        buildSlots(dv, o.toDisp, o.decimals, o.suffix, {pad: o.pad, editable: false, digitColor: d.digitColor,
                   signChar: d.sgn, signColor: d.col, refTxt: o.refTxt, refGhost: true}) + '</div>' +
    '</div>' +
    (o.sub != null ? '<div class="vsub">' + o.sub + '</div>' : ''),
    'vcell xedit', nodeAttr(o.node) + ' data-kind="' + o.kind + '" data-i="' + (o.vi - 1) + '"');
}
// read-only value cell: value + a digit-aligned delta below it (delta: false for the first checkpoint).
// o: col, cur, ref, toDisp, decimals, suffix, kind, sub, color, delta, refTxt, node
function gcellRo(o){
  var delta = o.delta !== false, dv = o.cur - o.ref, d = deltaLook(dv, o.toDisp, o.decimals, o.kind, 1e-9);
  var pad = fmtF(Math.abs(o.cur) * o.toDisp, o.decimals).split('.')[0].length;   // value's integer-digit width
  return vcellHtml(o.col,
    '<div class="vstack">' +
      '<div class="vmain digits"' + sty(o.color) + '>' +              // invisible sign slot: same width as the delta
        buildSlots(o.cur, o.toDisp, o.decimals, o.suffix, {pad: pad, editable: false,
                   signChar: delta ? '±' : null, signColor: 'transparent', refTxt: o.refTxt}) + '</div>' +
      (delta ? '<div class="vdelta digits">' +
        buildSlots(dv, o.toDisp, o.decimals, o.suffix, {pad: pad, editable: false, digitColor: d.digitColor,
                   signChar: d.sgn, signColor: d.col, refTxt: o.refTxt, refGhost: true}) + '</div>' : '') +
    '</div>' +
    (o.sub != null ? '<div class="vsub">' + o.sub + '</div>' : ''),
    'vcell', nodeAttr(o.node));
}
function bigop(sym, lo, up){
  return '<span class="bigop"><span class="lim up">' + up + '</span><span class="op">' + sym +
         '</span><span class="lim lo">' + lo + '</span></span>';
}
function mv(txt, col){ return '<span style="color:' + col + ';">' + txt + '</span>'; }
function metricGrow(label, color, cells, cls, row, formula, toggle){
  return '<div class="' + ('grow ' + (cls || '')).trim() + '" data-row="' + row + '">' +
    '<div class="rlabel" style="color:' + color + ';"><div class="rlblwrap">' +
      '<span class="rlbl">' + label + '</span>' +
      (formula ? '<div class="rformula">' + formula + '</div>' : '') + (toggle || '') +
    '</div></div>' + cells + '</div>';
}
// per-row "switch to the complement" button; its text names the view a click switches TO
function rtoggle(id, on, labelOff, labelOn){
  return '<button type="button" class="rtog' + (on ? ' on' : '') + '" data-input="' + id + '" data-on="' + (on ? '1' : '0') +
         '">&#8644;&nbsp;' + (on ? labelOn : labelOff) + '</button>';
}

// Dependency arrows (see arrow_edges in app_xrisk): for checkpoints j >= 2 each value comes from its
// row's previous value (h) and from rows above; a source in a hidden row is replaced by what that row
// was derived from, and an arrow that skips visible rows is type d.
var CROSS = {
  surv:   function(j){ return ['rate:' + (j - 1)]; },           // cs_t <- ae over the period ending at t
  years:  function(j){ return ['surv:' + j]; },                 // Y_t  <- cs_t
  gens:   function(j){ return ['surv:' + j]; },                 // G_t  <- cs_t
  popexp: function(j){ return ['pop:' + j, 'surv:' + j]; },     // E_t  <- P_t, cs_t
  ly:     function(j){ return ['popexp:' + j]; },               // H_t  <- E_t
  lives:  function(j){ return ['popexp:' + j]; }                // N_t  <- E_t
};
var HORIZ = ['surv', 'years', 'gens', 'ly', 'lives'];            // running totals
function arrowEdges(vis, n){
  function addU(arr, x){ if(arr.indexOf(x) < 0) arr.push(x); }
  function expand(id){
    var p = id.split(':'), row = p[0];
    if(vis.indexOf(row) >= 0) return [id];
    var out = [];
    if(CROSS[row]) CROSS[row](+p[1]).forEach(function(s){ expand(s).forEach(function(x){ addU(out, x); }); });
    return out;
  }
  var out = [];
  vis.forEach(function(row){
    for(var j = 2; j <= n; j++){
      if(HORIZ.indexOf(row) >= 0) addU(out, row + ':' + (j - 1) + ',' + row + ':' + j + ',h');
      var srcs = [];
      if(CROSS[row]) CROSS[row](j).forEach(function(s){ expand(s).forEach(function(x){ addU(srcs, x); }); });
      srcs.forEach(function(s){
        var skips = vis.indexOf(row) - vis.indexOf(s.split(':')[0]) > 1;
        addU(out, s + ',' + row + ':' + j + ',' + (skips ? 'd' : 'v'));
      });
    }
  });
  return out.join(';');
}

function isChecked(id){ var el = document.getElementById(id); return !!(el && el.checked); }
function visibleRows(){
  var on = varBoxes().filter(function(x){ return x.checked; }).map(function(x){ return x.value; });
  return ROWS.filter(function(r){ return on.indexOf(r) >= 0; });
}
function range1(n){ var a = []; for(var k = 1; k <= n; k++) a.push(k); return a; }

// The table. j = checkpoint and i = period, both 1-based as in the R version; arrays are 0-based.
function panelHtml(cur, ref){
  var m = M, n = m.n, np = n - 1, sr = isChecked('showref'), rc = rateComp, sc = survComp;
  var J = range1(n), I = range1(np), elapsed = [0];
  for(var k = 0; k < np; k++) elapsed.push(elapsed[k] + m.segLen[k]);
  function ycol(j){ return 2 * j; }                       // grid start for year j
  function gcol(i){ return 2 * i + 1; }                   // grid start for gap i (between years i and i+1)
  function rtxt(v, toDisp, decimals, suffix){ return sr ? fRef(v, toDisp, decimals, suffix) : null; }

  var header = '<div class="grow ghead"><div class="rlabel"></div>' + J.map(function(j){
    return '<div class="ycol" style="grid-column:' + ycol(j) + '/span 2;"><div class="yr">' + fmtYear(m.cps[j - 1]) + '</div></div>';
  }).join('') + '</div>';
  // period labels: on the annual-probability row above each period's box, or their own row if it is hidden
  var ivl = I.map(function(i){
    return '<div class="ivlcell" style="grid-column:' + gcol(i) + '/span 2;"><div>&larr; ' + m.segLen[i - 1] +
           ' years &rarr;</div><div class="ivlrng">' + fmtYear(m.segStart[i - 1]) + '&ndash;' + fmtYear(m.segEnd[i - 1]) + '</div></div>';
  }).join('');
  var intervals = '<div class="grow"><div class="rlabel"></div>' + ivl + '</div>';

  // formula symbols, each written in whichever variable the rows above currently show
  function sym(nm, k, col){ return mv(nm + '<sub>' + k + '</sub>', col); }
  function asv(k){ return rc ? sym('as', k, COL_RATE) : '(1 &minus; ' + sym('ae', k, COL_RATE) + ')'; }
  function csv(k){ return sc ? '(1 &minus; ' + sym('ce', k, COL_SURV) + ')' : sym('cs', k, COL_SURV); }
  var SUM = bigop('&sum;', 'i=2027', 't');

  // each row is built only when it is visible
  var rows = {
    rate: function(){                                   // editable, in the gaps between years
      var cells = I.map(function(i){
        var cv = rc ? 1 - cur.rates[i - 1] : cur.rates[i - 1], rv = rc ? 1 - ref.rates[i - 1] : ref.rates[i - 1];
        return gcellEdit({col: gcol(i), cur: cv, ref: rv, kind: rc ? 'rate_c' : 'rate', vi: i, toDisp: 100, decimals: 4,
          suffix: '%', good: rc ? 'more_good' : 'more_bad', color: COL_RATE, refTxt: rtxt(rv, 100, 4, '%'), node: 'rate:' + i,
          top: "<span class='ratio'>1 in " + fInt(1 / cur.rates[i - 1]) + '</span>' +      // odds of extinction either way
               (sr ? " <span class='ratio vref'>(1 in " + fInt(1 / ref.rates[i - 1]) + ')</span>' : '')});
      }).join('');
      return metricGrow((rc ? 'Annual survival probability' : 'Annual extinction probability') +
          "<br><span class='ital'>if survived until then</span>", COL_RATE, ivl + cells, 'erow rrow', 'rate',
          rc ? sym('as', 't', COL_RATE) + ' = 1 &minus; ' + sym('ae', 't', COL_RATE) : sym('ae', 't', COL_RATE),
          rtoggle('rate_comp', rc, 'Show annual survival', 'Show annual extinction'));
    },
    surv: function(){                                   // editable (backtraces into the rates)
      var cells = J.map(function(j){
        if(j === 1) return gcellFixed(ycol(1), sc ? 0 : cur.surv[0], 100, 4, '%', COL_SURV, 2, 'surv:1');
        var cv = sc ? 1 - cur.surv[j - 1] : cur.surv[j - 1], rv = sc ? 1 - ref.surv[j - 1] : ref.surv[j - 1];
        return gcellEdit({col: ycol(j), cur: cv, ref: rv, kind: sc ? 'surv_c' : 'surv', vi: j - 1, toDisp: 100, decimals: 4,
          suffix: '%', pad: 2, good: sc ? 'more_bad' : 'more_good', color: COL_SURV, refTxt: rtxt(rv, 100, 4, '%'), node: 'surv:' + j});
      }).join('');
      return metricGrow((sc ? 'Cumulative extinction probability' : 'Cumulative survival probability') +
          "<br><span class='ital'>given past " + (rc ? 'survival' : 'extinction') + ' probabilities</span>', COL_SURV, cells,
          'erow', 'surv',
          (sc ? sym('ce', 't', COL_SURV) : sym('cs', 't', COL_SURV)) + ' = ' + (sc ? '1 &minus; ' : '') +
            bigop('&prod;', 'i=2027', 't') + ' ' + asv('i'),
          rtoggle('surv_comp', sc, 'Show cumulative extinction', 'Show cumulative survival'));
    },
    years: function(){
      var cells = J.map(function(j){
        if(j === 1) return gcellRo({col: ycol(1), cur: cur.cumYears[0], ref: cur.cumYears[0], toDisp: 1, decimals: 4, suffix: 'y',
                                    delta: false, color: COL_SURV, node: 'years:1'});
        return gcellRo({col: ycol(j), cur: cur.cumYears[j - 1], ref: ref.cumYears[j - 1], toDisp: 1, decimals: 4, suffix: 'y',
          sub: 'of ' + fInt(elapsed[j - 1]) + 'y potential', color: COL_SURV, refTxt: rtxt(ref.cumYears[j - 1], 1, 4, 'y'),
          node: 'years:' + j});
      }).join('');
      return metricGrow('Cumulative survived years of humanity', COL_SURV, cells, '', 'years',
                        mv('Y<sub>t</sub>', COL_SURV) + ' = ' + SUM + ' ' + csv('i'));
    },
    gens: function(){
      var cells = J.map(function(j){
        if(j === 1) return gcellRo({col: ycol(1), cur: cur.gens[0], ref: cur.gens[0], toDisp: 1, decimals: 4, suffix: '',
                                    delta: false, color: COL_SURV, node: 'gens:1'});
        return gcellRo({col: ycol(j), cur: cur.gens[j - 1], ref: ref.gens[j - 1], toDisp: 1, decimals: 4, suffix: '',
          sub: 'of ' + fmtF(elapsed[j - 1] / LIFE_EXP, 2) + ' potential', color: COL_SURV, refTxt: rtxt(ref.gens[j - 1], 1, 4, ''),
          node: 'gens:' + j});
      }).join('');
      return metricGrow("Cumulative survived generations <span class='ital'>(75y)</span>", COL_SURV, cells, '', 'gens',
                        mv('G<sub>t</sub>', COL_SURV) + ' = ' + SUM + ' ' + csv('i') + ' / 75');
    },
    pop: function(){                                    // editable checkpoints; growth rate in the gaps
      var cells = J.map(function(j){
        return gcellEdit({col: ycol(j), cur: cur.popPot[j - 1], ref: ref.popPot[j - 1], kind: 'pop', vi: j, toDisp: 1 / 1e6,
          decimals: 0, suffix: 'm', pad: 5, good: 'more_good', color: COL_POP, node: 'pop:' + j});
      }).join('');
      var growth = I.map(function(i){
        var g = cur.growth[i] * 100;
        return '<div class="vgrowth" style="grid-column:' + gcol(i) + '/span 2;">' + (g >= 0 ? '+' : '') + fmtF(g, 3) + '%/yr</div>';
      }).join('');
      return metricGrow("Annual population potential<br><span class='ital'>if survived</span>", COL_POP, cells + growth,
                        'erow', 'pop', mv('P<sub>t</sub>', COL_POP));
    },
    popexp: function(){
      var cells = J.map(function(j){
        if(j === 1) return gcellRo({col: ycol(1), cur: cur.popExp[0], ref: cur.popExp[0], toDisp: 1, decimals: 0, suffix: '',
                                    delta: false, color: COL_POP, node: 'popexp:1'});
        return gcellRo({col: ycol(j), cur: cur.popExp[j - 1], ref: ref.popExp[j - 1], toDisp: 1, decimals: 0, suffix: '',
          sub: 'of ' + fInt(cur.popPot[j - 1]) + ' potential', color: COL_POP, node: 'popexp:' + j});
      }).join('');
      return metricGrow("Annual population<br><span class='ital'>given survival probability</span>", COL_POP, cells, '', 'popexp',
                        mv('E<sub>t</sub>', COL_POP) + ' = ' + mv('P<sub>t</sub>', COL_POP) + ' &middot; ' + csv('t'));
    },
    ly: function(){
      var cells = J.map(function(j){
        if(j === 1) return gcellRo({col: ycol(1), cur: cur.cumLy[0], ref: cur.cumLy[0], toDisp: 1, decimals: 0, suffix: '',
                                    delta: false, color: COL_POP, node: 'ly:1'});
        return gcellRo({col: ycol(j), cur: cur.cumLy[j - 1], ref: ref.cumLy[j - 1], toDisp: 1, decimals: 0, suffix: '',
          sub: 'of ' + fInt(cur.cumLyPot[j - 1]) + ' potential', color: COL_POP, node: 'ly:' + j});
      }).join('');
      return metricGrow('Cumulative lived human life-years', COL_POP, cells, '', 'ly',
                        mv('H<sub>t</sub>', COL_POP) + ' = ' + SUM + ' ' + mv('E<sub>i</sub>', COL_POP));
    },
    lives: function(){
      var cells = J.map(function(j){
        if(j === 1) return gcellRo({col: ycol(1), cur: cur.lives[0], ref: cur.lives[0], toDisp: 1, decimals: 0, suffix: '',
                                    delta: false, color: COL_POP, node: 'lives:1'});
        return gcellRo({col: ycol(j), cur: cur.lives[j - 1], ref: ref.lives[j - 1], toDisp: 1, decimals: 0, suffix: '',
          sub: fInt(cur.livesPot[j - 1] - cur.lives[j - 1]) + ' less than potential', color: COL_POP, node: 'lives:' + j});
      }).join('');
      return metricGrow("Cumulative lived human lives <span class='ital'>(75y)</span>", COL_POP, cells, '', 'lives',
                        mv('N<sub>t</sub>', COL_POP) + ' = ' + SUM + ' ' + mv('E<sub>i</sub>', COL_POP) + ' / 75');
    }
  };

  var vis = visibleRows();
  // --halfcol: column pitch cap for this horizon (see the .grow CSS comment)
  return '<div class="grid-scroll"><div class="grid-wrap" style="--ncols:' + (2 * n) + ';--halfcol:' +
         (Math.round(1.05 * (46 + 7 * n) * 10) / 10) + 'px;" data-edges="' + arrowEdges(vis, n) + '">' +
         header + (vis.indexOf('rate') < 0 ? intervals : '') +
         vis.map(function(r){ return rows[r](); }).join('') +
         (vis.length ? '' : '<div class="novars">No variables selected — pick some from the Variables menu.</div>') +
         '</div></div>';
}
function summaryHtml(cur){
  var n = M.n, total = 0;
  M.segLen.forEach(function(v){ total += v; });
  function hl(t, c){ return "<b style='color:" + c + ";'>" + t + '</b>'; }   // value in its row's colour
  return '<div class="summary">With these rates, humanity survives to ' + hl(fmtYear(M.cps[n - 1]), '#e8eef4') +
    ' with ' + hl(fPct(cur.surv[n - 1]), COL_SURV) + ' probability, is expected to live ' +
    hl(fYears(cur.cumYears[n - 1]), COL_SURV) + ' of the next ' + fInt(total) + ' years, and to accrue ' +
    hl(fInt(cur.lives[n - 1]), COL_POP) + ' human lives (' + hl(fInt(cur.cumLy[n - 1]), COL_POP) + ' life-years).</div>';
}
function footHtml(){
  return '<div class="foot">Population potential is interpolated geometrically between the checkpoints ' +
    pops.map(function(p){ return (p / 1e9).toFixed(1); }).join(' / ') +
    '&nbsp;bn, so it stays internally consistent. Lives = cumulative life-years &divide; 75.</div>';
}

// ── state, baselines and history ──
// rates / pops: the current state. The comparison baseline is either a frozen state ("Set baseline =
// current", mode 'current') or the state before the most recent change (mode 'previous') — the same
// rules app_xrisk's server applied.
var hscale = DEF_EXP, M = modelFor(hscale);
var rates = M.defRates.slice(), pops = M.defPops.slice();
var LEN = M.segLen.slice();                      // period lengths (years), for the survival backtrace
var rateComp = false, survComp = false;          // per-row complement views (the ⇄ buttons)
function snap(){ return {rates: rates.slice(), pops: pops.slice()}; }
var mode = 'previous', refStatic = snap(), histPrev = snap(), histLast = snap();
function refState(){ return fitState(mode === 'previous' ? histPrev : refStatic, M); }
var sel = {kind:'rate', i:0, place:0.00001, delta:false};  // first period, second-to-last decimal (0.001%); value/delta + which digit

// undo / redo: snapshots of {rates, pops}
var histStack = [snap()];
var histIdx = 0, histSuppress = false;
function histEq(a,b){ return a.rates.every(function(v,i){return v===b.rates[i];}) && a.pops.every(function(v,i){return v===b.pops[i];}); }
function updateHistBtns(){
  var u = document.getElementById('undoBtn'), r = document.getElementById('redoBtn');
  if(u) u.disabled = (histIdx <= 0);
  if(r) r.disabled = (histIdx >= histStack.length - 1);
}
function recordHistory(){
  if(histSuppress) return;
  var cur = snap();
  if(histEq(cur, histStack[histIdx])) return;        // no actual change
  histStack = histStack.slice(0, histIdx + 1);         // drop any redo tail
  histStack.push(cur); histIdx = histStack.length - 1;
  updateHistBtns();
}
function restoreHist(){
  var s = histStack[histIdx];
  histSuppress = true; rates = s.rates.slice(); pops = s.pops.slice(); pushState(); histSuppress = false;
  updateHistBtns();
}
function undo(){ if(histIdx > 0){ histIdx--; restoreHist(); } }
function redo(){ if(histIdx < histStack.length - 1){ histIdx++; restoreHist(); } }

// every change to rates / pops ends here: shift the "previous" baseline, record undo, redraw
function pushState(){ histPrev = histLast; histLast = snap(); recordHistory(); scheduleRender(); }

// Redraw: rebuild the table, summary and footer from the state, then restore the selection highlight,
// fit the columns, draw the arrows and keep the table's sideways scroll position. Several changes in
// one frame (a wheel spin, a held key) cost one redraw.
var renderQueued = false;
function scheduleRender(){ if(!renderQueued){ renderQueued = true; requestAnimationFrame(render); } }
function render(){
  renderQueued = false;
  var rs = refState(), cur = compute(rates, pops, M), ref = compute(rs.rates, rs.pops, M);
  var sc0 = document.querySelector('.grid-scroll'), scrollX = sc0 ? sc0.scrollLeft : 0;
  document.getElementById('panel').innerHTML = panelHtml(cur, ref);
  document.getElementById('summary').innerHTML = summaryHtml(cur);
  document.getElementById('foot').innerHTML = footHtml();
  var br = document.getElementById('setref'), bp = document.getElementById('setprev');
  if(br) br.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'current');
  if(bp) bp.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'previous');
  cellOf(sel);                                    // a ⇄ toggle renamed the selected cell's kind: follow it
  applyHighlight();
  watchArrows();
  var sc1 = document.querySelector('.grid-scroll'); if(sc1) sc1.scrollLeft = scrollX;
}

// the buttons that reset or rebase the state
function setBaselineCurrent(){ refStatic = snap(); mode = 'current'; scheduleRender(); }
function setBaselinePrevious(){ mode = 'previous'; scheduleRender(); }
function allSurvive(){                              // all x-risk → 0 (all survival 100%); deltas rebased to 0
  rates = rates.map(function(){ return 0; }); refStatic = snap(); mode = 'current'; pushState();
}
function resetDefaults(){
  rates = M.defRates.slice(); pops = M.defPops.slice();
  refStatic = snap(); histPrev = snap(); histLast = snap(); mode = 'previous'; pushState();
}
// Horizon changed: fit the state to the new number of periods (edits to shared periods kept) and rebase
// the baseline on it — a structural change, not an edit. The undo history restarts (its snapshots have
// the old length) and the selection is clamped so it can't point past the last column.
function setHorizon(e){
  if(!isFinite(e) || e === hscale) return;
  hscale = e; M = modelFor(e);
  var s = fitState(snap(), M);
  rates = s.rates; pops = s.pops; LEN = M.segLen.slice();
  refStatic = snap(); histPrev = snap(); histLast = snap();
  histStack = [snap()]; histIdx = 0;
  var last = (sel.kind === 'pop' ? pops.length : rates.length) - 1;   // rate/rate_c/surv/surv_c all index periods
  if(sel.i > last) sel.i = last;
  updateHistBtns(); scheduleRender();
}

// ── editing (as in app_xrisk) ──
// Complementary display kinds: the ⇄ buttons re-render rows 1-2 with data-kind rate_c / surv_c, whose
// value is 1 - the underlying one. Editing them writes back through the same rate / survival machinery.
// A selection survives the toggle by following its cell to the other kind name.
var ALT_KIND = { rate:'rate_c', rate_c:'rate', surv:'surv_c', surv_c:'surv' };
function cellOf(s){
  var c = document.querySelector('.xedit[data-kind="'+s.kind+'"][data-i="'+s.i+'"]');
  if(!c && ALT_KIND[s.kind]){ c = document.querySelector('.xedit[data-kind="'+ALT_KIND[s.kind]+'"][data-i="'+s.i+'"]'); if(c) s.kind = ALT_KIND[s.kind]; }
  return c;
}
function digsOf(c){ if(!c) return []; return Array.prototype.slice.call(c.querySelectorAll((sel.delta ? '.vdelta' : '.vmain') + ' .dig')); }
function allCells(){ return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.xedit')); }
function digDelta(el){ return parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-delta')); }
function nearestDig(digs, place){                // match a digit by its place value
  var best = 0, bd = Infinity;
  for(var k = 0; k < digs.length; k++){
    var d = Math.abs(Math.log(digDelta(digs[k])) - Math.log(place));
    if(d < bd){ bd = d; best = k; }
  }
  return best;
}
function applyHighlight(){
  allCells().forEach(function(c){
    var on = c.getAttribute('data-kind') === sel.kind && (+c.getAttribute('data-i')) === sel.i;
    c.classList.toggle('sel', on);
    c.querySelectorAll('.dig').forEach(function(d){ d.classList.remove('digsel'); });
    if(on){
      var digs = digsOf(c);
      if(digs.length){
        var idx = nearestDig(digs, sel.place);
        digs[idx].classList.add('digsel');
        sel.place = digDelta(digs[idx]);         // snap to an existing digit
      }
    }
  });
}
function survOf(arr, i){                          // cumulative survival through interval i
  var p = 1; for(var k = 0; k <= i; k++) p *= Math.pow(1 - arr[k], LEN[k]); return p;
}
// set survival at checkpoint i to target T by solving the interval-i extinction
// rate, backtracing into earlier intervals when T exceeds the prior survival.
function setSurv(i, T){
  T = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, T));               // 100% ceiling, 0 floor
  for(var m = i; m >= 0; m--){
    var Pprev = 1; for(var k = 0; k < m; k++) Pprev *= Math.pow(1 - rates[k], LEN[k]);
    var needed = T / Pprev;                       // desired (1-r_m)^len_m
    if(needed <= 1){ rates[m] = 1 - Math.pow(needed, 1 / LEN[m]); break; }
    rates[m] = 0;                                 // maxed this interval, keep backtracing
  }
  pushState();
}
function valOf(kind, i, rArr, pArr){
  if(kind === 'surv')   return survOf(rArr, i);
  if(kind === 'surv_c') return 1 - survOf(rArr, i);      // cumulative extinction probability
  if(kind === 'rate_c') return 1 - rArr[i];              // annual survival probability
  return (kind === 'rate' ? rArr : pArr)[i];
}
function curVal(){  return valOf(sel.kind, sel.i, rates, pops); }
function baseVal(){ var b = refState(); return valOf(sel.kind, sel.i, b.rates, b.pops); }
function setValAbs(v){                            // write the actual value (backtrace for surv)
  if(sel.kind === 'surv'){ setSurv(sel.i, v); }
  else if(sel.kind === 'surv_c'){ setSurv(sel.i, 1 - v); }
  else if(sel.kind === 'rate_c'){ rates[sel.i] = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, +(1 - v).toFixed(12))); pushState(); }
  else { var arr = (sel.kind === 'rate') ? rates : pops; arr[sel.i] = Math.max(0, +v.toFixed(12)); pushState(); }
}
// when sel.delta, we edit the change (value − baseline); otherwise the value itself
function editVal(){ return sel.delta ? (curVal() - baseVal()) : curVal(); }
function applyEdit(nv){ setValAbs(sel.delta ? baseVal() + nv : nv); }
function change(dir){                             // ▼ always lowers, ▲ always raises (monotonic)
  applyEdit(editVal() + dir * sel.place);         // crosses zero once, never flip-flops
}
// type a digit into the selected place (selection stays put)
function typeDigit(d){
  var place = sel.place, v = editVal(), av = Math.abs(v), sign = v < 0 ? -1 : 1;
  var cd = Math.floor(av / place + 1e-6) % 10;      // current digit at this place
  applyEdit(sign * (av + (d - cd) * place));
  moveDigit(1, false);                              // advance like a text field; stops at the last digit
}
// Move the selection one digit left (-1) / right (+1). cross = may step into the neighbouring cell
// (arrow keys do; typing does not, so a number entered in the last place just stays there).
function moveDigit(dir, cross){
  var cells = allCells(), cell = cellOf(sel); if(!cell) return;
  var digs = digsOf(cell), idx = nearestDig(digs, sel.place), ci = cells.indexOf(cell);
  if(dir > 0){
    if(idx < digs.length - 1) sel.place = digDelta(digs[idx + 1]);
    else if(cross && ci < cells.length - 1){ var nc = cells[ci + 1], nd = digsOf(nc);
      sel = {kind:nc.getAttribute('data-kind'), i:+nc.getAttribute('data-i'), place:digDelta(nd[0]), delta:sel.delta}; }
  } else {
    if(idx > 0) sel.place = digDelta(digs[idx - 1]);
    else if(cross && ci > 0){ var pc = cells[ci - 1], pd = digsOf(pc);
      sel = {kind:pc.getAttribute('data-kind'), i:+pc.getAttribute('data-i'), place:digDelta(pd[pd.length - 1]), delta:sel.delta}; }
  }
  applyHighlight();
}
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  var k = e.key;
  if(e.target.closest && e.target.closest('input, textarea, select, .vdrop')) return;  // keys aimed at a control (e.g. the Variables menu)
  if(/^[0-9]$|^Arrow/.test(k) && !cellOf(sel)){      // selected cell's row is hidden: jump to the first visible one, don't edit blind
    var c0 = allCells()[0]; if(!c0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var d0 = digsOf(c0); sel = {kind:c0.getAttribute('data-kind'), i:+c0.getAttribute('data-i'), place:d0.length ? digDelta(d0[0]) : sel.place, delta:false};
    applyHighlight(); return;
  }
  if(/^[0-9]$/.test(k)){ e.preventDefault(); typeDigit(+k); return; }
  if(['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].indexOf(k) < 0) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  if(k === 'ArrowUp')   { if(!sel.delta) change(1);  return; }   // ▲/▼ change values only, not deltas
  if(k === 'ArrowDown') { if(!sel.delta) change(-1); return; }
  moveDigit(k === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1, true);   // arrows may walk on into the next/previous cell
});
document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
  var cell = e.target.closest('.xedit'); if(!cell) return;
  var dig  = e.target.closest('.dig');
  if(dig){
    sel = {kind:cell.getAttribute('data-kind'), i:+cell.getAttribute('data-i'),
           place:digDelta(dig), delta: !!dig.closest('.vdelta')};
    var up = e.target.closest('.ar.up'), dn = e.target.closest('.ar.dn');
    if(up || dn){ change(up ? 1 : -1); return; }
    applyHighlight();
  } else {
    sel.kind = cell.getAttribute('data-kind'); sel.i = +cell.getAttribute('data-i'); sel.delta = false;
    applyHighlight();
  }
});
// mouse wheel over a digit nudges that digit (up = raise, down = lower).
// Accumulate delta and step per threshold so a touchpad gesture (many events +
// inertia) doesn't run the digit away — ~one step per notch / firm swipe.
var wheelAcc = 0;
document.addEventListener('wheel', function(e){
  var dig = e.target.closest('.dig'); if(!dig){ wheelAcc = 0; return; }
  var cell = dig.closest('.xedit'); if(!cell){ wheelAcc = 0; return; }
  if(dig.closest('.vdelta')){ wheelAcc = 0; return; }   // deltas: no wheel change (number keys only)
  e.preventDefault();
  var d = e.deltaY;
  if(e.deltaMode === 1) d *= 33; else if(e.deltaMode === 2) d *= 400;   // lines/pages → px
  if(wheelAcc !== 0 && (d < 0) !== (wheelAcc < 0)) wheelAcc = 0;         // direction flip → reset
  wheelAcc += d;
  var STEP = 90;
  if(Math.abs(wheelAcc) < STEP) return;
  sel = {kind:cell.getAttribute('data-kind'), i:+cell.getAttribute('data-i'),
         place:digDelta(dig), delta: !!dig.closest('.vdelta')};
  var n = 0;
  while(wheelAcc <= -STEP && n < 8){ wheelAcc += STEP; change(-1); n++; }
  while(wheelAcc >=  STEP && n < 8){ wheelAcc -= STEP; change(1);  n++; }
  if(n >= 8) wheelAcc = 0;   // guard against a pathological single event
}, {passive:false});

// ── dependency arrows (as in app_xrisk): SVG overlay on .grid-wrap, drawn from its data-edges ──
// type h: across a row (previous value → this one, at the value's line); v: from the row directly above;
// d: skips visible rows, so it loops round the boxes' left side.
// A value with an h arrow is its previous value *acted on* by the rows above (cs_2036 = cs_2026 · (1 − ae)^10),
// so its inputs from above don't enter the box: they join the h arrow with an arrowhead (see step 2).
var SVGNS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
function nodeBox(gw, base, id){
  var el = gw.querySelector('[data-node="' + id + '"]'); if(!el) return null;
  var r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), vm = el.querySelector('.vmain'), m = vm ? vm.getBoundingClientRect() : r;
  return {l:r.left - base.left, r:r.right - base.left, t:r.top - base.top, b:r.bottom - base.top,
          cx:(r.left + r.right) / 2 - base.left, my:(m.top + m.bottom) / 2 - base.top};
}
function drawArrows(){
  var gw = document.querySelector('.grid-wrap'); if(!gw) return;
  var old = gw.querySelector('svg.arrows'); if(old) old.remove();
  if(document.body.classList.contains('noarrows')) return;
  var spec = gw.getAttribute('data-edges'); if(!spec) return;
  var base = gw.getBoundingClientRect();
  var svg = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, 'svg');
  svg.setAttribute('class', 'arrows');
  svg.setAttribute('width', gw.scrollWidth); svg.setAttribute('height', gw.scrollHeight);
  svg.innerHTML = '<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 8 8" refX="7.5" refY="4" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse" ' +
                  'markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 z"/></marker></defs>';
  gw.appendChild(svg);                                            // attached first: paths get sampled while drawing
  function add(d, head){
    var p = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, 'path');
    p.setAttribute('class', 'e'); p.setAttribute('d', d); if(head) p.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#ah)');
    svg.appendChild(p); return p;
  }
  var edges = spec.split(';').map(function(e){
    var p = e.split(','); return {from:p[0], to:p[1], type:p[2], S:nodeBox(gw, base, p[0]), T:nodeBox(gw, base, p[1])};
  }).filter(function(e){ return e.S && e.T; });
  // 1 · across arrows; remember each one's segment so arrows from above can join it
  var hseg = {};
  edges.forEach(function(e){
    if(e.type !== 'h') return;
    var x0 = e.S.r + 1, x1 = e.T.l - 1;
    if(x1 - x0 < 6) return;                                       // boxes touching: no room for an arrow
    add('M' + x0 + ',' + e.S.my + ' L' + x1 + ',' + e.T.my, true);
    hseg[e.to] = {x0:x0, y0:e.S.my, x1:x1, y1:e.T.my};
  });
  // 2 · arrows from above. A box directly above feeds from its bottom-left corner (its output side); a
  // box sitting over the gap between years (the ae row) drops straight down from its centre.
  //   target has an across arrow  → every input joins that arrow just before the target
  //   otherwise                   → one input is the "trunk": it swings out left of the boxes, runs down,
  //                                 and enters the target's left edge; any other inputs join the trunk
  //                                 (E_t = P_t · cs_t: P's arrow meets the cs arrow on its way into E)
  var byT = {};
  edges.forEach(function(e){ if(e.type !== 'h') (byT[e.to] = byT[e.to] || []).push(e); });
  Object.keys(byT).forEach(function(to){
    var list = byT[to], T = list[0].T, h = hseg[to];
    if(h && h.x1 - h.x0 >= 22){
      list.forEach(function(e){
        var S = e.S, sy = S.b + 1, overGap = S.cx <= h.x1 - 12;
        if(e.type === 'd'){                                         // skips rows: go round their left side, then
          var xo = Math.min(S.l, T.l) - 16, xd = S.l + 5;           // drop onto the across arrow before the box
          if(xo >= h.x0 + 6){
            var jyd = h.y0 + (h.y1 - h.y0) * (xo - h.x0) / (h.x1 - h.x0);
            if((jyd - 1) - (sy + 12) >= 4){
              add('M' + xd + ',' + sy + ' Q' + xo + ',' + sy + ' ' + xo + ',' + (sy + 12) + ' L' + xo + ',' + (jyd - 1), true);
              return;
            }
          }
        }
        var sx = overGap ? S.cx : S.l + 5;
        var jx = overGap ? Math.max(S.cx, h.x0 + 8) : Math.max(h.x1 - 12, h.x0 + 8);
        var jy = h.y0 + (h.y1 - h.y0) * (jx - h.x0) / (h.x1 - h.x0);
        var cy = (sy + Math.min(T.t, jy)) / 2;
        add('M' + sx + ',' + sy + ' C' + sx + ',' + cy + ' ' + jx + ',' + cy + ' ' + jx + ',' + (jy - 1), true);
      });
      return;
    }
    // the trunk is the input from directly above (E_t: P_t is primary); inputs that skip rows join it
    var trunk = list.filter(function(e){ return e.type === 'v'; })[0] || list[0], S = trunk.S;
    var xo = Math.min.apply(null, [S.l, T.l].concat(list.map(function(e){ return e.S.l; }))) - 12;
    var sx = S.l + 5, sy = S.b + 1, tx = T.l - 1, ty = T.my;
    var straight = (ty - 10) - (sy + 12) >= 8;                      // room for a straight vertical run?
    var tp = add(straight
      ? 'M' + sx + ',' + sy + ' Q' + xo + ',' + sy + ' ' + xo + ',' + (sy + 12) + ' L' + xo + ',' + (ty - 10) +
        ' Q' + xo + ',' + ty + ' ' + (xo + 10) + ',' + ty + ' L' + tx + ',' + ty
      : 'M' + sx + ',' + sy + ' C' + xo + ',' + (sy + 16) + ' ' + xo + ',' + ty + ' ' + tx + ',' + ty, true);
    // Where the trunk turns down: its leftmost point (topmost, if it runs straight for a while). Joins land
    // exactly there, whichever shape the trunk took. The path is in the SVG, so it can be sampled.
    var px = Infinity, py = sy, L = tp.getTotalLength ? tp.getTotalLength() : 0;
    for(var k = 0; k <= 60; k++){
      var pt = tp.getPointAtLength(L * k / 60);
      if(pt.x < px - 0.5){ px = pt.x; py = pt.y; }
    }
    if(!isFinite(px)){ px = xo; py = sy + 12; }
    var y1 = straight ? ty - 10 : py;                               // bottom of the straight run (if any)
    list.forEach(function(e){
      if(e === trunk) return;
      var jsx = e.S.l + 5, jsy = e.S.b + 1;
      if(e.type === 'd'){
        // from further up: swing out to the trunk's line and run straight down it, landing where it turns down
        add((py - 1) - (jsy + 12) >= 4
          ? 'M' + jsx + ',' + jsy + ' Q' + px + ',' + jsy + ' ' + px + ',' + (jsy + 12) + ' L' + px + ',' + (py - 1)
          : 'M' + jsx + ',' + jsy + ' C' + px + ',' + jsy + ' ' + px + ',' + (py - 10) + ' ' + px + ',' + (py - 1), true);
        return;
      }
      var jy = y1 - py >= 8 ? Math.min(Math.max(jsy + 14, py + 4), y1 - 4) : py;   // on the trunk's straight run
      add(jsx - 10 > px ? 'M' + jsx + ',' + jsy + ' Q' + jsx + ',' + jy + ' ' + (jsx - 10) + ',' + jy + ' L' + (px + 1) + ',' + jy
                        : 'M' + jsx + ',' + jsy + ' L' + (px + 1) + ',' + jy, true);
    });
  });
}
// Column floor: every value box, year, period label and growth note sits centred at its natural
// (one-line) width, so the widest one is the smallest pitch at which nothing overlaps. Each cell spans
// two half-columns, so half of that (plus a little air) becomes --halfmin for every row's grid. Box
// widths don't depend on the column width, so this can't feed back on itself; it runs once per render.
function fitColumns(){
  var gw = document.querySelector('.grid-wrap'); if(!gw) return;
  var w = 0;
  gw.querySelectorAll('.vcell, .ycol, .ivlcell, .vgrowth').forEach(function(el){
    var cs = getComputedStyle(el);
    var tot = el.getBoundingClientRect().width + parseFloat(cs.marginLeft) + parseFloat(cs.marginRight);
    if(tot > w) w = tot;
  });
  gw.style.setProperty('--halfmin', Math.ceil(w / 2 + 3) + 'px');
}
// Redraw the arrows whenever the table's box changes size (window resize, formulas toggled, fonts
// loading). Each render replaces .grid-wrap, so the observer is re-attached every time.
var arrowRO = window.ResizeObserver ? new ResizeObserver(function(){ requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows); }) : null;
function watchArrows(){
  var gw = document.querySelector('.grid-wrap');
  if(arrowRO){ arrowRO.disconnect(); if(gw) arrowRO.observe(gw); }
  fitColumns();
  drawArrows();
}
window.addEventListener('resize', function(){ requestAnimationFrame(drawArrows); });
if(document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(function(){ fitColumns(); drawArrows(); });

// ── controls ──
document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
  if(e.target.closest('#undoBtn')) undo();
  else if(e.target.closest('#redoBtn')) redo();
  else if(e.target.closest('#surv100')) allSurvive();
  else if(e.target.closest('#reset')) resetDefaults();
  else if(e.target.closest('#setref')) setBaselineCurrent();
  else if(e.target.closest('#setprev')) setBaselinePrevious();
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  var z = (e.key === 'z' || e.key === 'Z'), y = (e.key === 'y' || e.key === 'Y');
  if((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && z && !e.shiftKey){ e.preventDefault(); undo(); }
  else if((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && (y || (z && e.shiftKey))){ e.preventDefault(); redo(); }
});
$(document).on('change', '#showarrows', function(){ document.body.classList.toggle('noarrows', !this.checked); drawArrows(); });
$(document).on('change', '#showfx', function(){ document.body.classList.toggle('nofx', !this.checked); });
$(document).on('change', '#showref', scheduleRender);
// per-row complement toggles (rendered inside the table)
$(document).on('click', '.rtog', function(){
  if(this.getAttribute('data-input') === 'rate_comp') rateComp = !rateComp; else survComp = !survComp;
  scheduleRender();
});
// Variables dropdown: live "k / n" count on the button, All / None shortcuts, close on an outside click.
function varBoxes(){ return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#vars input[type=checkbox]')); }
function updateVarCount(){
  var b = varBoxes(), c = document.querySelector('.vdrop .vcount');
  if(c) c.textContent = b.filter(function(x){ return x.checked; }).length + ' / ' + b.length;
}
$(document).on('change', '#vars input[type=checkbox]', function(){ updateVarCount(); scheduleRender(); });
document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
  var a = e.target.closest('.vall a');
  if(a){
    e.preventDefault();
    var on = a.getAttribute('data-vars') === 'all';
    varBoxes().forEach(function(x){ x.checked = on; });
    $('#vars input[type=checkbox]').first().trigger('change');   // one change event → one redraw
    return;
  }
  var d = document.querySelector('.vdrop[open]');
  if(d && !d.contains(e.target)) d.removeAttribute('open');
});
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  if(e.key === 'Escape'){ var d = document.querySelector('.vdrop[open]'); if(d) d.removeAttribute('open'); }
});
// Time scale: the slider holds the exponent (2..5). Read it from the slider itself on either of its
// change signals; setHorizon ignores repeats.
function readScale(){
  var s = $('#hscale').data('ionRangeSlider');
  return s ? +s.result.from : parseInt($('#hscale').val(), 10);
}
$(document).on('change', '#hscale', function(){ setHorizon(readScale()); });
$(document).on('shiny:inputchanged', function(ev){ if(ev.name === 'hscale') setHorizon(+ev.value); });
// slider labels: show the reader "100 y / 1 000 y / 10 000 y / 100 000 y" instead of the exponent
function fmtScale(n){ return String(Math.pow(10, n)).replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ' ') + ' y'; }
$(document).on('shiny:connected', function(){
  var s = $('#hscale').data('ionRangeSlider');
  if(s) s.update({ prettify: fmtScale });
});

// first draw: the page's controls are already in place, so the table needs nothing from the server
updateHistBtns();
render();
)"

ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$head(tags$style(HTML(css))),
  div(class = "wrap",
    h1("Expected longevity of humanity under extinction risk"),
    p(class = "lead",
      "Each period's annual extinction probability cascades into survival ",
      "probability, population, and cumulative human life lived. ",
      "Deltas compare against the frozen baseline."),
    p(class = "khint lead2", HTML(
      "Edit any <b>extinction probability</b>, <b>survival probability</b>, or ",
      "<b>population potential</b> digit &mdash; click its ",
      "<span class='kbd'>&#9650;</span>/<span class='kbd'>&#9660;</span>, or select and use ",
      "<span class='kbd'>&larr;</span><span class='kbd'>&rarr;</span><span class='kbd'>&uarr;</span><span class='kbd'>&darr;</span>, ",
      "or type <span class='kbd'>0</span>&ndash;<span class='kbd'>9</span> to set the digit. ",
      "Survival edits backtrace into the earlier extinction rates.")),
    div(class = "controls",
      tags$button(id = "undoBtn", type = "button", class = "btn", title = "Undo (Ctrl+Z)",
                  disabled = NA, HTML("&#8630;&nbsp;Undo")),
      tags$button(id = "redoBtn", type = "button", class = "btn", title = "Redo (Ctrl+Y)",
                  disabled = NA, HTML("Redo&nbsp;&#8631;")),
      actionButton("surv100", "100% survival", class = "btn"),
      actionButton("reset", "Reset to defaults", class = "btn"),
      checkboxInput("showfx",    "Show formulas", TRUE, width = "auto"),
      checkboxInput("showarrows", "Show arrows", TRUE, width = "auto")),
    # second row: which variables are shown, the baseline choice, and the time scale
    div(class = "controls",
      # Variables: which metric rows are rendered. A hidden row isn't built at all, so its cells
      # can't be clicked, arrowed into or wheel-edited.
      tags$details(class = "vdrop",
        tags$summary(class = "btn", "Variables ",
          span(class = "vcount", sprintf("%d / %d", length(VAR_ON), length(VAR_ROWS))),
          HTML(" &#9662;")),
        div(class = "vmenu",
          div(class = "vall",
            tags$a(href = "#", `data-vars` = "all", "All"), " · ",
            tags$a(href = "#", `data-vars` = "none", "None")),
          checkboxGroupInput("vars", NULL, choices = VAR_ROWS, selected = VAR_ON))),
      actionButton("setref",  "Set baseline = current", class = "btn"),
      actionButton("setprev", "Set baseline = previous value", class = "btn active"),
      checkboxInput("showref",   "Show baseline values", FALSE, width = "auto"),
      # Horizon: 100 / 1 000 / 10 000 / 100 000 years. The slider holds the exponent (2..5); a JS prettify
      # hook shows the reader the year count instead. Default 1 000 keeps the first load light.
      div(class = "scalectl",
        span(class = "khint", "Time scale"),
        sliderInput("hscale", NULL, min = min(SCALE_EXP), max = max(SCALE_EXP), value = DEF_EXP,
                    step = 1, ticks = FALSE, width = "170px"))),
    # filled by the JavaScript on every change
    div(id = "panel"),
    div(id = "summary"),
    div(id = "foot"),
    tags$script(HTML(js)))
)

# Nothing to do per edit: the page computes and draws everything itself (see the header).
server <- function(input, output, session) {}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
<!-- XRISK-APP:END -->

### Threshold curve editor

Below is an alternative prototype where you sketch the whole risk profile as a curve rather than typing numbers. Drag the red **extinction-probability-per-year** handles or the blue population handles across the timeline (years 0–1110 over three log-spaced spans). This allows more customizability on what x-risk probabilities the user sets for which time period.

[Open the app full-screen in a new tab ↗](https://villeseppala.github.io/interests/articles/hazard-app.html){target="_blank"}

<!-- HAZARD-APP:START -->
```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: "clamp(900px, 92vh, 1150px)"
# ============================================================================
# Shiny — hazard/survival threshold controls (value-space, bidirectional).
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Curve interpolated in VALUE space (cubic Hermite on value vs fx), mapped
# through the y-axis for drawing, so it bends where it crosses a decade band.
#
# Two control sets, one authoritative at a time ("driver"):
#   * Hazard set (red): anchors value+slope, per-segment controls -> hazard(fx),
#     survival derived by S=prod(1-h)^dy.
#   * Survival set (blue): same handles on the survival curve -> survival(fx),
#     hazard derived by h = 1 - (S_i/S_{i-1})^(1/dy).
# Grabbing a handle makes its set the driver; the other set is greyed and just
# tracks the derived curve.  Default hazard peaks around year 20.
#
# Run:  shiny::runApp("hazard_thresholds.R")
# ============================================================================

required <- c("shiny")   # the SVG overlay draws every curve now, so ggplot2 is no longer needed
missing  <- required[!vapply(required, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) install.packages(missing)

library(shiny)

## ---- constants + shared helpers -------------------------------------------
SPANX <- c(10, 90, 900, 9000); M <- 100; Wpx <- 1240; Hpx <- 698   # 4 periods to 12026, width matches x-risk app
YEARS   <- c(2026, 2036, 2126, 3026, 12026)                        # checkpoint calendar years (same as x-risk)
year_lbl <- function(y) if (y >= 10000) format(y, big.mark = " ", scientific = FALSE) else as.character(y)

haz_to_fy <- function(h) {
  h <- pmin(1e-1, pmax(1e-5, h)); d <- floor(log10(h)); seg <- pmin(3, pmax(0, d + 5))
  lo <- 10^(seg-5); hi <- 10^(seg-4); (seg + pmin(1, pmax(0, (h-lo)/(hi-lo)))) / 4
}
fit_linexp <- function(mx) max(-5, min(-1, floor(log10(mx)) + 1))
herm <- function(px, x0, y0, m0, x1, y1, m1) {
  h <- x1 - x0; u <- (px-x0)/h
  y0*(2*u^3-3*u^2+1) + m0*h*(u^3-2*u^2+u) + y1*(-2*u^3+3*u^2) + m1*h*(u^3-u^2)
}
default_atheta <- function(anchors) {
  fy <- haz_to_fy(anchors); px <- (0:4)/4*Wpx; py <- (1-fy)*Hpx; th <- numeric(5)
  for (i in 1:5) { lo <- max(1,i-1); hi <- min(5,i+1); th[i] <- atan2(py[hi]-py[lo], px[hi]-px[lo]) }
  th
}
sample_set <- function(anchors, thetaL, thetaR, fxc, cval, useCtrl, dYdv, clampV, log_time = FALSE, spanx = SPANX) {
  tfrac <- function(u) if (log_time) (10^u - 1) / 9 else u   # log: single decade of time per span
  rows <- list()
  for (s in 1:4) {
    fxL <- (s-1)/4; fxR <- s/4; hL <- anchors[s]; hR <- anchors[s+1]
    mL <- tan(thetaR[s])*Wpx/dYdv(hL); mR <- tan(thetaL[s+1])*Wpx/dYdv(hR); mC <- (hR-hL)/(fxR-fxL)
    fxC <- fxc[s]; hC <- cval[s]; ms <- if (s==1) 0:M else 1:M; fx <- fxL + (ms/M)*(fxR-fxL)
    u <- ms/M; dy <- spanx[s] * (tfrac(u) - tfrac(u - 1/M))   # years covered by each sample
    v <- if (useCtrl) ifelse(fx<=fxC, herm(fx,fxL,hL,mL,fxC,hC,mC), herm(fx,fxC,hC,mC,fxR,hR,mR))
         else herm(fx,fxL,hL,mL,fxR,hR,mR)
    rows[[s]] <- data.frame(fx = fx, val = clampV(v), dy = dy)
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
haz_dYdv <- function(h, lm, linearY) {
  if (linearY) return(-Hpx/lm)
  h <- pmin(1e-1, pmax(1e-5, h)); seg <- pmin(3, pmax(0, floor(log10(h))+5))
  lo <- 10^(seg-5); hi <- 10^(seg-4); -(Hpx/4)/(hi-lo)
}
compute_both <- function(hz, sv, driver, useCtrl, linearY, log_time = FALSE, spanx = SPANX) {
  if (driver == "hazard") {
    lm <- if (linearY) 10^fit_linexp(max(hz$anchors)) else 1
    hs <- sample_set(hz$anchors, hz$thetaL, hz$thetaR, hz$fxc, hz$cval, useCtrl,
                     function(h) haz_dYdv(h, lm, linearY), function(v) pmin(1e-1, pmax(1e-5, v)), log_time, spanx)
    surv <- cumprod((1 - hs$val)^hs$dy)
  } else {
    ss <- sample_set(sv$anchors, sv$thetaL, sv$thetaR, sv$fxc, sv$cval, useCtrl,
                     function(v) -Hpx, function(v) pmin(1, pmax(0, v)), log_time, spanx)
    ss$val <- cummin(pmax(1e-6, ss$val))                  # survival is non-increasing
    prev <- c(1, head(ss$val, -1)); r <- pmin(1, pmax(1e-9, ss$val/prev))
    hs <- data.frame(fx = ss$fx, val = pmin(1e-1, pmax(1e-5, 1 - r^(1/ss$dy))), dy = ss$dy)
    surv <- ss$val
    lm <- if (linearY) 10^fit_linexp(max(hs$val)) else 1
  }
  fy_of <- function(v) if (linearY) pmin(1, pmax(0, v/lm)) else haz_to_fy(v)
  data.frame(fx = hs$fx, fy = fy_of(hs$val), hz = hs$val, surv = surv)
}

## ---- JS overlay -----------------------------------------------------------
overlay_js <- HTML(r"---(
(function(){
  const NS="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const HAZ="#e8836f", SUR="#4fb8d6", HBAR="#c96f5c", SBAR="#3f9ab5";
  const POP="#e46ba6", PBAR="#a84e7d";
  const CYR="#6fcf97", CLY="#e8b04f", CLV="#b98fe0";   // cumulative: survived years / life-years / lives
  let popMax=1e10;    // population axis ceiling; grows by decades (10 B, 100 B, ...)
  const POP_DEFAULT={ anchors:[8.3e9,8.3e9,8.3e9,8.3e9,8.3e9], thetaL:[0,0,0,0,0], thetaR:[0,0,0,0,0], fxc:[0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5], cval:[8.3e9,8.3e9,8.3e9,8.3e9] };
  const PAL=["#1a9850","#91cf60","#fdae61","#d73027"];
  const YRS0=[2026,2050,2100];                         // default checkpoints: fixed 2026 start + 2 wheels (add up to 5)
  let yearVals=YRS0.slice();                            // current (wheel-adjustable) checkpoint years
  let SPANX=[10,90,900,9000];                           // period lengths = diffs of yearVals (mutated in place)
  const WHEEL_FLOOR=2*YRS0[0]-YRS0[1], WHEEL_CEIL=1e6;   // first end mirrored; last end reaches year 1,000,000
  function recomputeSpanx(){ for(let s=0;s<ns();s++) SPANX[s]=yearVals[s+1]-yearVals[s]; }
  function yearRange(i){ const last=yearVals.length-1;
    if(i===0) return [WHEEL_FLOOR, yearVals[1]];
    if(i===last) return [yearVals[last-1], WHEEL_CEIL]; return [yearVals[i-1], yearVals[i+1]]; }
  // only the last knob is logarithmic (in ELAPSED years from the 2026 start, so its long
  // horizon spreads across the dial); the interior knobs interpolate linearly between neighbours.
  function isLogWheel(i){ return i===yearVals.length-1; }
  function yearFromFrac(i,f){ const r=yearRange(i);
    if(isLogWheel(i)){ const st=yearVals[0], eLo=Math.max(1,r[0]-st), eHi=Math.max(eLo+1,r[1]-st); return st+eLo*Math.pow(eHi/eLo,f); }
    return r[0]+f*(r[1]-r[0]); }
  function fracFromYear(i,y){ const r=yearRange(i);
    if(isLogWheel(i)){ const st=yearVals[0], eLo=Math.max(1,r[0]-st), eHi=Math.max(eLo+1,r[1]-st), e=Math.max(eLo,y-st); return Math.log(e/eLo)/Math.log(eHi/eLo); }
    return (y-r[0])/(r[1]-r[0]); }
  function fmtYearShort(y){ y=Math.round(y);                          // compact for the small dial labels
    if(y>=1e9) return (y/1e9)+"B"; if(y>=1e6) return Math.round(y/1e6)+"M"; return y.toLocaleString(); }
  function np(){ return yearVals.length; }             // active checkpoint count (2..5)
  function ns(){ return yearVals.length-1; }           // active segment count
  // checkpoint i -> x-fraction [0,1]. equal periods (default) or linear-in-years when linearX.
  function cpFx(i){ const n=ns(); if(linearX){ const sp=yearVals[n]-yearVals[0]; if(sp>0) return (yearVals[i]-yearVals[0])/sp; } return i/n; }
  const M=100, GRAB=15, LEV=34, LIN_EMIN=-5, LIN_EMAX=-1;
  const EDGE_IN=9;   // inset (user units, ~one digit) for the first/last checkpoint readouts
  const YDEAD=5;   // px of sideways travel ignored before an anchor drag starts moving its year (keeps vertical drags from drifting)
  let showPoints=true, useCtrl=false, split=true, linearY=true, logTime=false, linearX=true, driver="hazard";
  // which handle family was grabbed last: "hazard" (normal view) or "pop" (population readouts shown at every
  // checkpoint, the hazard/survival readouts faded to 30% so the numbers stay readable). Flips on the next grab.
  let focusSet="hazard";
  let visHaz=true, visSurv=true, visPop=true, visCumYr=false, visCumLy=false, visCumLives=false;
  let minorGrid=[];
  function tFrac(u){ return logTime ? (Math.pow(10,u)-1)/9 : u; }   // log: single decade of time per span
  let linExp=-1, linMax=0.1;
  // Scale transitions (linear hazard scale + population scale): the plot spans 0..TOPF x the scale max, i.e. 11
  // grid units of which the top one (10..11, unlabeled) is a red transition zone; the bottom 10% is another.
  // Releasing a handle inside the top zone grows that scale a decade; releasing with EVERY current value of that
  // variable inside the bottom zone shrinks it to fit. Baseline ("previous") values never count. See fitExp().
  const TOPF=1.1, ZONE_FILL="rgba(255,0,0,0.2)";
  let W,H, hazSet={anchors:[],ctrls:[]}, survSet={anchors:[],ctrls:[]}, popSet={anchors:[],ctrls:[]}, hazS=[], survS=[], popS=[];
  let surTicks=[];   // survival axis labels (right gutter)
  let yTicks=[], popTicks=[], cumYrTicks=[], cumLyTicks=[], cumLvTicks=[], infoTx=[], bandsG, bandSig="", svg, label, hazArea, hazLine, surLine, popLine, expLine, segSep=[], connLines=[], ptLabels=[], readySent=false, drag=null;
  let baseHazLine, baseSurLine, basePopLine, baseExpLine, cumYrLine, cumLyLine, cumLvLine;
  let baseCumYrLine, baseCumLyLine, baseCumLvLine;
  let baseMode="previous", baseSnap=null, prevSnap=null;   // comparison: "none" | "current" | "previous"

  const clampHaz=h=>Math.max(1e-5,Math.min(1e-1,h)), clamp01=v=>Math.max(0,Math.min(1,v)), sX=fx=>fx*W;
  function hazToFyDec(h){ h=clampHaz(h); let seg=Math.min(3,Math.max(0,Math.floor(Math.log10(h))+5));
    const lo=Math.pow(10,seg-5),hi=Math.pow(10,seg-4); return (seg+Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(h-lo)/(hi-lo))))/4; }
  const sYh=h=>linearY?(1-clamp01(h/(linMax*TOPF)))*H:(1-hazToFyDec(h))*H;
  const hazFromFy=fy=>linearY?clampHaz(clamp01(fy)*linMax*TOPF):(function(){let seg=Math.min(3,Math.floor(clamp01(fy)*4)),frac=clamp01(fy)*4-seg,
    lo=Math.pow(10,seg-5),hi=Math.pow(10,seg-4);return lo+frac*(hi-lo);})();
  const survTop=()=>linearY?TOPF:1;   // survival 100% sits on the 10th tick, under the top transition zone (full height in decade mode)
  const sYs=s=>(1-s/survTop())*H;
  const ratio=h=>Math.round(1/clampHaz(h)).toLocaleString();
  function foldClamp(a){ if(a>Math.PI/2)a-=Math.PI; else if(a<-Math.PI/2)a+=Math.PI; return Math.max(-1.35,Math.min(1.35,a)); }
  function herm(px,x0,y0,m0,x1,y1,m1){ const h=x1-x0,u=(px-x0)/h;
    return y0*(2*u*u*u-3*u*u+1)+m0*h*(u*u*u-2*u*u+u)+y1*(-2*u*u*u+3*u*u)+m1*h*(u*u*u-u*u); }
  function dScreenYdh(h){ if(linearY) return -H/(linMax*TOPF); h=clampHaz(h);
    const seg=Math.min(3,Math.max(0,Math.floor(Math.log10(h))+5)),lo=Math.pow(10,seg-5),hi=Math.pow(10,seg-4); return -(H/4)/(hi-lo); }
  // variable descriptors
  const HDESC={ yOf:sYh,        invY:py=>hazFromFy(1-py/H), clampV:clampHaz, dYdv:dScreenYdh, col:HAZ, bar:HBAR, ratioLbl:v=>"1 in "+ratio(v)+" ("+(v*100).toFixed(4)+"%)" };
  const SDESC={ yOf:sYs, invY:py=>clamp01((1-py/H)*survTop()), clampV:clamp01, dYdv:()=> -H/survTop(),      col:SUR, bar:SBAR, ratioLbl:v=>(v*100).toFixed(1)+"% surv" };
  const sYp = p=>(1-clamp01(p/(popMax*TOPF)))*H;
  const PDESC={ yOf:sYp, invY:py=>clamp01(1-py/H)*popMax*TOPF, clampV:p=>Math.max(0,Math.min(1e15,p)), dYdv:()=>-H/(popMax*TOPF), col:POP, bar:PBAR, ratioLbl:v=>Math.round(v/1e6).toLocaleString()+" M pop" };
  function maxPopVal(){ let m=0; for(let i=0;i<np();i++){ if(popSet.anchors[i].val>m)m=popSet.anchors[i].val; } popS.forEach(p=>{ if(p.val>m)m=p.val; }); return m; }
  // new decade exponent for a scale whose max is 10^cur: a value in the top zone (above the scale max) -> one decade
  // up; every value inside the bottom zone (below 10% of the max) -> shrink until the max is above 10%; else unchanged.
  function fitExp(mx, cur, lo, hi){ let e=cur;
    if(mx>Math.pow(10,e)) e=Math.ceil(Math.log10(mx));
    else if(mx>0&&mx<0.1*Math.pow(10,e)) e=Math.floor(Math.log10(mx))+1;
    return Math.max(lo,Math.min(hi,e)); }
  function fitPop(){ popMax=Math.pow(10, fitExp(maxPopVal(), Math.round(Math.log10(popMax)), 10, 14)); }
  // A scale change must not change any value: the lever angles are screen-space, so the value-space slope they
  // encode (tan(theta) * W / dYdv, with dYdv proportional to 1/scaleMax) would otherwise change with the scale.
  // Re-express every lever so its value slope is preserved: tan(new) = tan(old) * oldMax / newMax. The result may
  // exceed the angle range the mouse can reach (that is fine - the curve is what matters, not reproducibility).
  function rescaleLevers(set, factor){ const lim=Math.PI/2-0.01;
    set.anchors.forEach(a=>{ a.thetaL=Math.max(-lim,Math.min(lim,Math.atan(Math.tan(a.thetaL)*factor)));
                             a.thetaR=Math.max(-lim,Math.min(lim,Math.atan(Math.tan(a.thetaR)*factor))); }); }
  // comparison baseline snapshot (sampled value arrays, aligned by index)
  function snap(){ return { fx:hazS.map(p=>p.fx), haz:hazS.map(p=>p.val), surv:survS.map(p=>p.val), pop:popS.map(p=>p.val), dy:popS.map(p=>p.dy) }; }
  function activeBase(){ return baseMode==="previous"?prevSnap:(baseMode==="current"?baseSnap:null); }
  function curveValAt2(fxA,valA,fx){ if(fx<=fxA[0])return valA[0]; for(let i=1;i<fxA.length;i++){ if(fxA[i]>=fx){ const t=(fx-fxA[i-1])/(fxA[i]-fxA[i-1]); return valA[i-1]+t*(valA[i]-valA[i-1]); } } return valA[valA.length-1]; }
  // stack labels so higher value sits higher (smaller y) with a minimum gap
  function stackByValue(items,gap){ items.sort((a,b)=>b.val-a.val); for(let i=1;i<items.length;i++){ if(items[i].y<items[i-1].y+gap) items[i].y=items[i-1].y+gap; } return items; }
  function updateCmpBtns(){ const c=document.getElementById("baseCur"), p=document.getElementById("basePrev");
    if(c) c.classList.toggle("active", baseMode==="current"); if(p) p.classList.toggle("active", baseMode==="previous"); }
  function setByName(n){ return n==="hazard"?hazSet:(n==="pop"?popSet:survSet); }
  function descByName(n){ return n==="hazard"?HDESC:(n==="pop"?PDESC:SDESC); }
  function fmtM(v){ return Math.round(v/1e6).toLocaleString(); }
  function fmtBig(v){ const a=Math.abs(v); if(a>=1e12)return (v/1e12).toFixed(2)+" T"; if(a>=1e9)return (v/1e9).toFixed(2)+" B"; if(a>=1e6)return (v/1e6).toFixed(1)+" M"; return Math.round(v).toLocaleString(); }
  function pctLbl(v){ const p=v*100; if(p<=0) return "0%"; let t=parseFloat(p.toPrecision(3)).toString();   // axis labels: 3 sig. figs, no trailing zeros
    if(t.indexOf("e")>=0) t=p.toFixed(8).replace(/0+$/,""); return t+"%"; }

  function mk(t,a){ const e=document.createElementNS(NS,t); for(const k in a) e.setAttribute(k,a[k]); return e; }
  function mouse(e){ const r=svg.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:(e.clientX-r.left)*(W/r.width), y:(e.clientY-r.top)*(H/r.height)}; }
  function setFont(px){ let st=document.getElementById("ovFont"); if(!st){ st=document.createElement("style"); st.id="ovFont"; document.head.appendChild(st); }
    st.textContent="#overlay text{font-size:"+px+"px;}"; }   // one CSS rule overrides every SVG label
  function maxHaz(){ let m=0; for(let i=0;i<np();i++){ if(hazSet.anchors[i].val>m) m=hazSet.anchors[i].val; }
    if(useCtrl) for(let s=0;s<ns();s++){ if(hazSet.ctrls[s].val>m) m=hazSet.ctrls[s].val; } hazS.forEach(p=>{ if(p.val>m) m=p.val; }); return m; }   // every current hazard value (handles + curve)
  // when a baseline is shown, the scale must also cover its values so the ghost lines aren't clipped
  function baseMaxHaz(){ const B=activeBase(); let m=0; if(B) B.haz.forEach(v=>{ if(v>m) m=v; }); return m; }
  function baseMaxPop(){ const B=activeBase(); let m=0; if(B) B.pop.forEach(v=>{ if(v>m) m=v; }); return m; }
  function setLinExp(e){ e=Math.max(LIN_EMIN,Math.min(LIN_EMAX,e)); linExp=e; linMax=Math.pow(10,e); }
  function fitLinExp(){ setLinExp(fitExp(maxHaz(), linExp, LIN_EMIN, LIN_EMAX)); }

  // Gutter axes, identical on both sides: every visible label is placed beside its gridline (labels that would overlap
  // are stacked, see layoutSide) and a bracket (tick from the plot edge + spine along the stack) ties them to that line. Hidden curves drop their labels. The primary
  // text elements (yTicks/surTicks/popTicks/cum*Ticks) carry the content; the left column mirrors them each redraw.
  // The wrapper's padding is set from the rendered label widths (scaled to CSS px) so nothing is clipped.
  const LANE_PAD=13, LANE_BR=7;   // label x offset from the plot edge; bracket x offset
  let axisBrR=[], axisBrL=[];     // bracket pool per side: {h: tick from plot edge, v: spine along the stacked labels}
  const BR_POOL=14;
  const hazTickY=k=>linearY?(1-(k/4)/TOPF)*H:(1-k/4)*H;   // hazard label rows: 0..scale max = the lower 10 of 11 units in linear mode
  const popTickY=fr=>(1-fr/TOPF)*H;                       // population rows likewise
  let mirror=null;                // left-side copies: {haz,sur,pop,cy,cl,cv}
  function fontU(el){ const f=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize); return isFinite(f)&&f>0?f:11; }   // CSS px == user units inside the viewBox
  function layoutSide(sgn, S, brs){   // sgn -1 = left column (end-anchored), +1 = right column (start-anchored); returns gutter width in user units
    const xLab=sgn<0?-LANE_PAD:W+LANE_PAD, anc=sgn<0?"end":"start";
    const items=[], groups=[];   // items: every visible label with its gridline y; groups: one per distinct gridline
    const put=(el,y,on)=>{ el.setAttribute("x",xLab); el.setAttribute("text-anchor",anc); el.setAttribute("opacity",on?1:0);
      if(on&&el.textContent){ let g=groups.find(q=>Math.abs(q.y-y)<1); if(!g){ g={y:y,lo:y,hi:y}; groups.push(g); } items.push({el:el,y:y,g:g}); } };
    S.haz.forEach((t,k)=>put(t,hazTickY(k),visHaz));
    S.sur.forEach((t,k)=>put(t,(1-(k/4)/survTop())*H,visSurv));
    S.pop.forEach((t,j)=>put(t,popTickY([1,0.5,0][j]),visPop));
    [[S.cy,visCumYr],[S.cl,visCumLy],[S.cv,visCumLives]].forEach(([els,on])=>els.forEach((t,j)=>put(t,[0,H/2,H][j],on)));
    brs.forEach(br=>{ br.h.setAttribute("opacity",0); br.v.setAttribute("opacity",0); });
    if(!items.length) return LANE_PAD+4;
    // 1-D label placement: sort by gridline (stable, so a gridline's labels stay together in variable order), merge
    // labels that would overlap into clusters centred on the mean of their gridlines, and keep every cluster inside
    // the plot height. Labels therefore sit on or as near as possible to their gridline without ever overlapping.
    const lh=fontU(items[0].el)*1.25;
    items.sort((a,b)=>a.y-b.y);
    const cl=[];
    items.forEach((it,i)=>{ let c={a:i,b:i,sum:it.y}; cl.push(c);
      for(;;){ const cnt=c.b-c.a+1; c.first=Math.max(0,Math.min(H-(cnt-1)*lh, c.sum/cnt-(cnt-1)*lh/2));
        const p=cl[cl.length-2]; if(!p||p.first+(p.b-p.a+1)*lh<=c.first+1e-6) break;
        p.b=c.b; p.sum+=c.sum; cl.pop(); c=p; } });
    let maxW=0;
    cl.forEach(c=>{ for(let i=c.a;i<=c.b;i++){ const it=items[i], y=c.first+(i-c.a)*lh;
      it.el.setAttribute("y",y); it.g.lo=Math.min(it.g.lo,y); it.g.hi=Math.max(it.g.hi,y);
      const w=it.el.getComputedTextLength(); if(w>maxW) maxW=w; } });
    // bracket per gridline: tick at the line, spine from the line to wherever its labels ended up
    groups.forEach((g,r)=>{ const br=brs[r]; if(!br) return; const y1=Math.min(g.y,g.lo), y2=Math.max(g.y,g.hi);
      br.h.setAttribute("y1",g.y); br.h.setAttribute("y2",g.y); br.h.setAttribute("opacity",0.8);
      br.v.setAttribute("y1",y1); br.v.setAttribute("y2",y2); br.v.setAttribute("opacity",y2-y1>1?0.8:0); });
    return LANE_PAD+maxW+4; }
  function layoutLanes(){ if(!svg||!mirror) return;
    const R={haz:yTicks, sur:surTicks, pop:popTicks.map(t=>t.el), cy:cumYrTicks, cl:cumLyTicks, cv:cumLvTicks};
    for(const k in R) R[k].forEach((t,i)=>{ const m=mirror[k][i]; m.textContent=t.textContent; m.setAttribute("fill",t.getAttribute("fill")); });   // sync left copies
    const leftU=layoutSide(-1, mirror, axisBrL), rightU=layoutSide(1, R, axisBrR);
    const col=document.getElementById("chartcol"); if(!col) return;
    const r=svg.getBoundingClientRect(), sc=r.width>0?r.width/W:1;   // user units -> CSS px at the current plot scale
    col.style.paddingLeft=Math.ceil(leftU*sc)+"px"; col.style.paddingRight=Math.ceil(rightU*sc)+"px"; }
  function paletteColor(i){ return PAL[Math.max(0,Math.min(3,i))]; }
  function rebuildBands(){ bandsG.innerHTML="";
    if(!linearY){ for(let b=0;b<4;b++){ const yBot=(1-b/4)*H,yTop=(1-(b+1)/4)*H,hgt=yBot-yTop;
      bandsG.appendChild(mk("rect",{x:0,y:yTop,width:W,height:hgt,fill:"none",stroke:paletteColor(b),"stroke-width":1.5,opacity:0.85}));
      if(b>0) for(let k=1;k<=10;k++){ const yy=yBot-(k/10)*hgt;
        bandsG.appendChild(mk("line",{x1:0,y1:yy,x2:W,y2:yy,stroke:paletteColor(b-1),"stroke-width":1,opacity:0.28})); } } }
    else { const u=H/(10*TOPF);   // one grid unit; the plot is 11 units tall
      bandsG.appendChild(mk("rect",{x:0,y:0,width:W,height:u,fill:ZONE_FILL,stroke:"none"}));          // top transition zone (10..11)
      bandsG.appendChild(mk("rect",{x:0,y:H-u,width:W,height:u,fill:ZONE_FILL,stroke:"none"}));        // bottom transition zone (0..1)
      // zone captions: what happens on release (inline font-size so the font slider does not touch them)
      const zt=(y,txt)=>{ const t=mk("text",{x:W/2,y:y,"text-anchor":"middle","dominant-baseline":"middle",fill:"#ffffff",opacity:0.28,"font-weight":"bold",
        "letter-spacing":"0.12em",style:"font-size:"+Math.round(u*0.34)+"px;"}); t.textContent=txt; bandsG.appendChild(t); };
      zt(u/2,   "10*SCALE");
      zt(H-u/2, "0.1*SCALE");
      bandsG.appendChild(mk("rect",{x:0,y:0,width:W,height:H,fill:"none",stroke:paletteColor(linExp+4),"stroke-width":1.5,opacity:0.85}));
      for(let k=1;k<=10;k++){ const yy=H-k*u; bandsG.appendChild(mk("line",{x1:0,y1:yy,x2:W,y2:yy,stroke:paletteColor(linExp+3),"stroke-width":1,opacity:0.28})); } } }
  function updateYTicks(){ for(let k=0;k<yTicks.length;k++){ const fy=k/4;
    let txt; if(linearY){ const h=fy*linMax; txt=pctLbl(h); yTicks[k].setAttribute("fill",HAZ); }
    else { txt=pctLbl(Math.pow(10,k-5)); yTicks[k].setAttribute("fill",paletteColor(Math.min(3,k))); } yTicks[k].textContent=txt; } }

  function sampleSet(set, desc){
    const out=[], n=ns();
    for(let s=0;s<n;s++){ const fxL=cpFx(s),fxR=cpFx(s+1),segw=fxR-fxL||1e-6,hL=set.anchors[s].val,hR=set.anchors[s+1].val;
      const mL=Math.tan(set.anchors[s].thetaR)*W/desc.dYdv(hL), mR=Math.tan(set.anchors[s+1].thetaL)*W/desc.dYdv(hR);
      const fxC=fxL+set.ctrls[s].fxc*segw,hC=set.ctrls[s].val,mC=(hR-hL)/segw;   // ctrls[s].fxc is a within-segment fraction 0..1
      for(let m=(s===0?0:1);m<=M;m++){ const fx=fxL+(m/M)*segw, dy=SPANX[s]*(tFrac(m/M)-tFrac((m-1)/M));
        let v=useCtrl?(fx<=fxC?herm(fx,fxL,hL,mL,fxC,hC,mC):herm(fx,fxC,hC,mC,fxR,hR,mR)):herm(fx,fxL,hL,mL,fxR,hR,mR);
```
